content:
Research task (read-only, use webfetch/websearch tools).

Fetch these two pages and report their full contents regarding album grades:
1. https://www.robertchristgau.com/get_artist.php?name=Fiona+Apple
2. https://www.robertchristgau.com/get_artist.php?name=Paula+Cole

For each artist, list every album shown on the page with its Christgau grade (e.g. A-, B+, B, C+, or "dud") and the year. Note especially any albums listed WITHOUT a letter grade (e.g. ones marked "not rated" or appearing only in a discography with no grade).

If those URLs fail, try:
- https://www.robertchristgau.com/get_artist.php?id=3919 (or search the site)
- Google cache / Wikipedia mentions of Robert Christgau grades for "Tidal" (1996), "When It's Down to It Is" / "It's All Right", "This Fire" (1996), "This Woman on the Fire", "Duotones" (1993), "Paula Cole" EPs.

Also report: Fiona Apple's albums released before 1999 (Tidal, 1996; plus any EP/live albums like "Extraordinary Machine" was 2005 — confirm), and Paula Cole's albums released before 1999 (Duotones 1993, This Fire 1996, and any others like "Nightingale"? confirm — she had "Harbinger" in 2007, "Raven" 2013).

Return a concise factual report listing exactly which albums are graded and which lack letter grades on Christgau's site.
